reason: No historical candidate established a gain: the supplied scores vary widely and overlap their controls. I rank A-transpose fusion first because it directly tests removing the full timed transpose and scratch traffic, while its repeated A loads make the result uncertain. Packed-A tile reuse tests a different way to reduce A traffic without repacking. Streaming-region fusion is a low-change cost test. The pointer and scheduling proposals are plausible but may already be optimized by the compiler or add overhead. B packing, output copying, and scalar B-transpose paths add substantial work or give up SME MOPA. All proposals need correctness checks and fresh serial AC controls; this order claims no speedup or individual cause.
